name: Energy Delivery Attribute 10
definition: Information related to energy derivatives attributes.

DeliveryInterval.name: Delivery Interval
DeliveryInterval.definition: Time interval for each block or shape.

DeliveryDate.name: Delivery Date
DeliveryDate.definition: Definition of delivery start date and end date.

WeekDay.name: Week Day
WeekDay.definition: Days of the week of the delivery.

DeliveryCapacity.name: Delivery Capacity
DeliveryCapacity.definition: Delivery capacity for each delivery interval specified.

QuantityUnit.name: Quantity Unit
QuantityUnit.definition: Daily or hourly quantity in MWh or kWh/d which corresponds to the underlying commodity.

PriceTimeIntervalQuantity.name: Price Time Interval Quantity
PriceTimeIntervalQuantity.definition: Indicates if applicable the price per quantity per delivery time interval.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
